description: Hand-labelled SYNTHETIC job descriptions for evaluating SkillAlign's rule-based skill extractor. Written and labelled by the developers (not real postings, not an external dataset). Labels list catalogue skills only; 'required' vs 'optional' follows the wording of each description.

items.text: Junior Python Developer. Must know Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Experience with Git is required. Docker is a plus.
Data Analyst Intern: strong SQL and MS Excel skills; ability to build dashboards in Power-BI. Good communication skills.
Frontend Engineer - build UIs with React.js, HTML5 and CSS3. Solid JavaScript (ES6). Nice to have: Git workflow experience.
We need someone who will excel in a fast-paced team. Strong problem-solving and collaboration. No Java experience required; Python preferred.
Machine Learning Engineer. Build ML models with Python, Pandas and NumPy. Solid statistics background. Experience with Docker containers is desirable.
Backend developer (Java 17, Spring Boot). Good knowledge of data structures and algorithms. SQL databases. Linux command line.
Business Intelligence Analyst. Tableau or Power BI dashboards; advanced Excel; data analytics; stakeholder communication.
Django web developer. Python, Django ORM, HTML and CSS templates. Postgres. Version control with GitHub.
DevOps trainee: Linux administration, shell scripting and Docker. Knowledge of Python is a plus.
Customer support associate. Excellent verbal communication. Team player. Familiarity with spreadsheets is welcome.
Full-stack developer: JavaScript, React, Node.js and REST APIs. Database: PostgreSQL. Docker and Kubernetes are a bonus.
Research assistant (statistics). Statistical analysis in Python 3 with NumPy and Pandas; Machine-learning exposure preferred.
Software Developer. Core Java, OOP, DSA. Must write clean code and solve problems efficiently. SQL.
QA Engineer: test web applications built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Write SQL queries for test data. Linux is good to have.
API developer using FastAPI and Python. Containerization with Docker. Git. PostgreSQL knowledge is an advantage.
Reporting analyst. Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP), Power BI, SQL. Analysing data from multiple sources.
Graduate trainee - no prior programming experience needed. Strong written communication and analytical thinking.
XML and JSON integration specialist. Experience with Java and REST. HTML email templates are a plus.
Data scientist: Python, pandas dataframes, numpy arrays, scikit-learn machine learning, statistical methods. Tableau preferred.
Mobile developer (Kotlin, Swift). Git required. Not a JavaScript role.
Database administrator: PostgreSQL tuning, backups, SQL performance, Linux servers. Docker optional.
UI developer. Strong CSS and HTML; React JS experience; collaboration with designers; communication skills.
Analytics engineer: data analysis with SQL and Python; dashboarding in Tableau; Git version control.
Java backend developer with algorithmic problem solving skills. Knowledge of JavaScript is not mandatory.
Operations executive: MS Excel, strong communication, and the ability to excel at multitasking.
Python automation engineer: Python scripts on Unix, GitLab CI, Docker. Pandas would be a bonus.
Teaching assistant for Data Structures and Algorithms in Java. Clear communication with students.
Marketing analyst (Google Analytics, SEO). Excel and basic statistics. Power BI familiarity is welcome.
Web developer intern: HTML, CSS, JavaScript; React preferred; teamwork and problem solving.
Technical writer. Excellent written communication. Familiarity with Git and HTML is a plus.
